start.text: The new defenses are in place. This attack does not break in. It crowds the door.
start.name: Joshua

A.text: Joshua! It floods the box from every side, it shoots from many sources at once, and it leaves slow connections that never close.
A.name: Carla

B.text: A flood, many sources and a slow drip. That is three tricks.
B.name: Joshua

C.text: Nothing is stolen. It only wants the site to stop.
C.name: Carla

D1.text: [b][color=red]Flood[/color][/b]: too much at once. [b][color=red]Many sources[/color][/b]: thousands of senders, each aiming at you. [b][color=red]Slow drip[/color][/b]: connections that stay and fill the room.
D1.name: Carla

D2.text: That depends on the upgrades you equipped. Each trick has one defense that stops it. Without it, the trick comes back [b][color=red]harder[/color][/b].
D2.name: Carla

E.text: Use your cards to hit it, and [b][color=green]Cap[/color][/b] the big hits. When it attacks, you dodge. Keep going until it is [b][color=green]contained[/color][/b].
E.name: Carla

F.text: Understood. Let's keep the site up.
F.name: Joshua

G.text: Everything I set up in Hardening is about to be tested.
G.name: Joshua
